name: Grant Sputore
bio:
Grant Sputore is an Australian film director, producer, writer, and podcast host. He made his directorial debut with the 2019 sci-fi thriller film I Am Mother and is directing the upcoming Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire sequel. He is also the founder of the production company The Penguin Empire.

credits.title: Godzilla x Kong: Supernova
credits.overview: Godzilla and Kong return in an all-new adventure as Earth's greatest titans face an unthinkable threat from beyond the stars. When a cosmic predator, Apex, sets its sights on Earth, only the combined might of monsters and humanity can avert total extinction.

credits.title: We Bury the Dead
credits.overview: After a catastrophic military disaster reanimates the dead, Ava searches for her missing husband amidst an increasingly hostile world.

credits.title: I Am Mother
credits.overview: A teenage girl is raised underground by a robot "Mother", designed to repopulate the earth following an extinction event. But their unique bond is threatened when an inexplicable stranger arrives with alarming news.

credits.title: Legacy
credits.overview: Australia, 1943. On leave from the front, Donald makes one last attempt to save his brother from the life their father has unwittingly prepared for him.
